blurb: Rockfish Charters offers saltwater fishing trips in the New York City area targeting striped bass and bluefin tuna. They operate a high-speed 39 foot Contender boat equipped for offshore fishing and comfort for up to six people. Trips run from April 15th through December 1st, fishing various locations including the New York Bight and Hudson Canyon.
extraNote: Howard Beach, Queens (right behind JFK airport) for striped bass season; Center Moriches, NY for tuna season · April 15th through December 1st
